description: This file defines the 'SeriesElements' class, a collection representing the values in a data series within a charting component of MigraDoc. It includes methods for adding points and serializing data, as well as internal handling of series values.

classes.name: SeriesElements
classes.description: A collection class representing the values in a data series, capable of adding points, serializing, and cloning.

classes.name: SeriesElements.SeriesElementsValues
classes.description: Internal class encapsulating the nullable property values of a SeriesElements instance.

methods.name: SeriesElements
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the collection with default values.

methods.name: .ctor
methods.description: Internal constructor initializing with a parent DocumentObject.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the SeriesElements instance.

methods.name: AddBlank
methods.description: Adds a null value point to the series.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a point with a specified double value to the series.

methods.name: Add (params double[] values)
methods.description: Adds multiple points with specified double values to the series.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the series elements into a format suitable for DDL output.
